item.title: Katy's original Landry's restaurant closes after 45 years; launched Fertitta empire
item.description: The Katy restaurant that launched Tilman Fertitta's multibillion-dollar hospitality empire has closed after 45 years of operation.

item.title: Two found dead in Katy home; children heard gunshots, Harris County deputies say
item.description: Two people were found dead from apparent gunshot wounds in a Katy-area home early Monday morning after the couple's adult children heard gunfire, according to the Harris County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Nine Katy ISD Dancers Named Texas All-State Performers
item.description: Nine Katy Independent School District dancers have been named Texas Dance Educators Association All-State Dancers, one of the highest honors in Texas dance education.

item.title: Faith, football, and red suspenders: Mike Johnston remembered by colleagues and Katy leaders

item.title: Katy area double homicide victims identified
item.description: The couple was found shot to death at their home at 3718 Bent Springs Lane at approximately 6 a.m. Monday, Jan. 12, after one of their sons called 911.

item.title: Union Kitchen Katy closes after 5 years at Stableside at Falcon Landing
item.description: The restaurant at 9920 Gaston Road in Stableside at Falcon Landing, across from Tompkins High School, shut down Jan. 11, according to a Jan. 14 announcement on the restaurant's Facebook page.

item.title: Copenhagen European Kitchen & Bakery to close Sunday after 4 years in Katy
item.description: A family-owned European restaurant in on Mason Road in Katy will serve its final meals Sunday, January 18, after four years in business.

item.title: Waller County economic development leader explains how jobs, tax base build sustainable communities
item.description: Economic development serves as the foundation for sustainable communities, requiring both strong capital investment and quality jobs, according to Waller County Economic Development Partnership Executive Director Vince Yokom.

item.title: Former County Judge Glenn Beckendorff Endorses Brian Cantrell for Commissioner
item.description: Waller County Fire Marshal Brian Cantrell has received the endorsement of former County Judge Glenn Beckendorff in his campaign for Precinct 4 commissioner.
